GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear trav well to Straightening Up , lay out @ 300 Collared x 200 Couldn'T Go On - veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have near hind abrasions, consistent with being - # galloped on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in during the early part of the home straight before being corrected passing the 200m. A post-race vet exam revealed near hind abrasions, consistent with being galloped on.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear , led x 2 Lengths @ 500m, Hard Ridden Straightening Up held a margin until the 100 Couldn'T Go On - # unable to pinch it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Momentarily became unbalanced near the 900m. Approaching the winning post shifted in under pressure, contacting the running rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 1x1 2 Lengths with cover enjoyed good trail to Straightening Up , clear run home Outside Joined in x 200m then was just No Match - had its chance - # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay in leaving the 300m and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 3rd Inside 2 Lengths off leader/winner same to straightening up Ridden Along 2nd x 100 Closest on line, # had its chance
Jumped Fast Settled Down 5th Inside 4 Lengths same to straightening up Ridden Along clear run home Outside Kept Trying Closest on line, # ran on evenly
Slow out & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn , Held Up home turn and initially on straightening, kept trying to post # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up round home turn and in the early stages of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, ridden positively and Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence (fast pace), Held Together out front & led 3 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight before being Headed and quickly bested at the 150m. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted early/middle stages (strong pace set). App. jockey advised he was obliged to pressure it early to cross runners drawn inside, and he was then reluctant to overly restrain it due to past breathing condition episodes when overly restrained. Trainer confirmed the instructions and racing characteristics. Explanations noted.] # led/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When asked about tactics in the early and middle stages, particularly the strong pace set during that stage of the race, Rdr advised from the wide barrier, was obliged to pressure gelding early to cross inside runners and was then reluctant to overly restrain gelding as has shown in the past it does have a breathing condition if overly restrained. Tnr confirmed instructs, and also racing characteristics of gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast comf Went Forward Settled Down 3 Lengths Clear left alone to Straightening Up 2 Lengths clr, Under Pressure from 300 Collared x 150 Couldn'T Go On and # fell into 2nd

Slow Out 2.0 Lengths (jumped in the air), settled down second last out 4 deep no cover 2 Lengths (700m), same to turn & into the Straight , all out 250 trying to get on terms, faded out of it # tardy/wide no cover
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped in the air as the start was effected and lost ground. Raced wide throughout.
